decisive_items: an incomplete transverse fracture in the lateral cortex of the right femoral neck
had received denosumab for osteoporosis for five years
T2-weighted magnetic resonance imaging demonstrated a high-signal bend in the same region
response.rationale: The patient's history of denosumab use and the presence of a transverse fracture in the lateral cortex of the right femoral neck are consistent with atypical femoral fracture.
